reviews.text: Pancetta comes here for 5 years and a half and it has always been great. The professionals really do care for the animals. She has had a paw treatment due to stepping on glass, dental cleaning, and the regular check ups!
Wonderful, caring, and trustworthy vet practice! The entire team treats my dog with so much warmth and patience. Highly recommended to any pet owner

Neighbor with cat in dire need, dying cannot be helped. No appointment possible because they are fully booked. Incomprehensible, very bad. Just stopped by, same vague story. It turned out someone had cancelled, but they still weren't going ahead with it. The blonde secretary said there are many reasons behind it. It is scandalous that it works like this. You can't use this clinic for an emergency, and then they come up with a vague story. Very bad.

Very kind vets and assistants. They’re responsive when you need any kind of help (paid or unpaid) and take your concerns seriously. I have taken my cat here from when she was 8 weeks old and I have since moved neighborhoods but keep coming back because I trust their care. They also helped me when I moved to the US and needed specific health documentation and vaccines. My cat is extremely anxious and can get quite aggressive but this hasn’t stopped them from being kind and caring. This is not a private equity backed large chain and you can tell — highly recommended.

I have been bringing my animals to this fantastic team at Rivierenbuurt Veterinary Clinic for a long time.

For the "ordinary things," such as vaccinations and check-ups, but especially when there is more going on, such as illness, old age, and the difficult choices that come with them.
The team is ready to help with expertise, warmth, and attention. They think along with you, advise, consult, and importantly: always in the best interest of the animal.

Now that my young cat, after 2 weeks of intensive veterinary care, enormous amounts of care, expertise, and trust from Manon, Nicole, Eva, Noelle, and the rest of the team, is keeping an eye on the garden together with his brother again, it seemed like a good moment to write this review.

The team at Dierenkliniek Rivierenbuurt has looked very well after our cat and assisted with EU pet passports, flea meds, and advice. They're friendly, caring, and very accommodating of stressed out pets and pet-parents.
Very nice veterinarians and assistants.

Bruno had his first “afspraak” we did all enjoyed a very good service and support.

Thank you to all of you for your advice with the puppy— support and general recommendations!

Cheers 🥂
Very friendly and professional staff from start to finish. Very helpful and willing to think along; I bring my Bengal cat here with peace of mind.

I have had nothing but good experiences; with enormous expertise and a huge amount of love for animals, I can always get quick assistance from this team. They are good at communication and honest about the possibilities and limitations. They have an optimal eye and ear for both the animal and the owner.

I just spoke to the manager, I was told that she will cancel my insurance which btw feels like an extreme scam for what I pay for every month and barely anything is covered, but at least with the situation of feeding my dog chicken when she's allergic will be rectified, was also told to delete my review that I had left before, crazy to be asked that in a country where I still have FREEDOM OF SPEECH! I had my opinion, said it, and won't be taking it back. I unfortunately, saw there will be no fee waivering or financial compensation from this mistake, so I will be thinking of reporting this type of negligence.

To be very honest, I’ve worked with this vet clinic for the past two years since I moved from the United States and I’ve had problems with them off the bat but decide to give them another chance. The vet my dog would originally work with was always so rude and dismissive, but we always had conversations about her food and how she’s DEADLY allergic to chicken and can’t eat any. I currently pay insurance for this clinic which kind of now feels like a scam now that I have to pay so much to help my dog get better from a virus. She wasn’t eating or drinking and started to poop blood when they decided to take her in and give her a IV infusion and that’s when they decided to feed her digestive care but SUPRISING TO FIND OUT , they fed her chicken stew canned digestive care food when I had told the vet and everyone else that we had spoken to in the clinic about the allergy, they have admitted to the mistake and how they never put it in the file in red like they are suppose to which is their responsibility. This is negligence and just outright malpractice, and now will reaching to others to advice on how to handle this situation. I still haven’t heard back from the manager or anything. I won’t be paying anything else after this mistake which made her poop blood right after instead of making her better they made her worse.
Very friendly people, good information throughout all procedures and fair prices, even less than the first indication
Nice vet

Very-very good clinic!

Super attentive and easy to communicate with.
Handled our beloved cat with all the care, providing swift response and appointment scheduling for an emergency we had.

Also provide us good tips for aftercare and followed-up during the week.

Service is fine so long as you act like a number on a computer. My dog had a hernia, VET ordered to avoid all movements, he is also travelling in 21 days and needs a vaccine before the 21 days are up. All i came for was a vaccine, and because my dog can't move I got a car that got stuck in traffic. I arrived 20 minutes late, fully ready to wait extra or pay a little late fee. Mind you, they always make you wait 10 minutes in the lobby so I figured considering his situation they would show some heart. Well nope, I was not there at the exact moment they wanted me there so I can turn tail and go to hell for all they cared. Not even a single effort was made to give him his shot, one shot, not a full body exam. All he needed was one single shot. They do not value their patients, they value the money they bring in. And if they are handed an excuse not to see you, then that is exactly what they will do. To them you are just a number on the screen, and when it comes to those who tend to my dog's health, the last thing you want is someone to treat your dog like a mere number.
Super knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive folks! They always give great advice and look after my pug with utmost care. 100% recommended!
Daatje is not an easy kitten, but was completely put at ease by this amazing vet. Back home with a vaccine and deworming tablet.
very cute nut cat
Best in Amsterdam!
Professional, lovely staff.
What great guys!

The kindness, the care, the thoroughness, the professionalism, both our dogs literally run into this vets doors, our one even lies outside it when it’s closed waiting for it to open. They are the best, even in one absolute emergency to general check ups.

The care for our cat at this veterinary clinic was absolutely wonderful! 🐾 Very kind and friendly staff, combined with true professionalism. Our cat recovered in no time thanks to their quick and effective help. We’re very grateful and happy to have found such great veterinary care! ❤️ …
Super team
Our dog has been going to this clinic for 15 years and 3 months: always to our complete satisfaction and with expert care.

I am 1000% satisfied with Dierenkliniek Rivierenbuurt!

For a while, I went to two different veterinary practices, and there I received very unpleasant advice for my cats Ginger and Pepper.
I am very happy to be back with these super sweet ladies!

The doctors and Désirée, the assistant, and of course the other assistants too!
